samples.summary: Shared-document sheet view is editable for the `editor` share role but never passes `onUndoJump`/`undoJumpTarget`, so cross-tab undo stays silently broken there — and the new prop doc asserts the opposite
samples.evidence: `packages/frontend/src/app/shared/shared-document.tsx:300` renders `<SheetView tabId={activeTabId} readOnly={readOnly} peerJumpTarget={peerJumpTarget} />` with `readOnly = resolved.role === "viewer"` (line 198), i.e. an `editor`-role share link gets a fully writable engine with Cmd+Z enabled. That layout has its own multi-tab state (`activeTabId`, line 200) and already implements the identical two-step jump for peers (lines 228-237), but no `onUndoJump`/`undoJumpTarget` wiring. With `onUndoJump` omitted, `Sheet.applyUndoSelection` returns early for `otherTab` selections, so an undo of a step in another tab mutates the CRDT and appears to do nothing — exactly the defect this PR fixes for `document-detail.tsx`. The new JSDoc at `packages/frontend/src/app/spreadsheet/sheet-view.tsx:163-167` claims the omission is "the read-only share view … moot there since undo is disabled", which is false for the editor role. Fix belongs in shared-document.tsx (mirror the peer-jump wiring) or, at minimum, correct the comment.

samples.summary: `handleUndoJump` switches `activeTabId` to whatever tab id the store reported, without checking the tab still exists or is a sheet-type tab
samples.evidence: `document-detail.tsx` renders `DataSourceView` / `LakehouseView` / `SheetView` by `activeTab?.type` (lines 744-769) and derives `activeTab = root.tabs[activeTabId]` (line 669). `handleUndoJump` calls `setActiveTabId(selection.tabId)` unconditionally; `selection.tabId` comes from a CRDT operation path under `$.sheets.<tabId>`, which is not guaranteed to have a live entry in `root.tabs` (tab deletion removes `r.tabs[id]` and `r.sheets[id]` separately at document-detail.tsx:510). A tabId present in `sheets` but absent from `tabs`/`tabOrder` yields an `activeTab === undefined` state where the TabBar highlights nothing and SheetView mounts on a tab the user cannot navigate away from by clicking. Guarding the switch against `root.tabs[selection.tabId]` would close it.

samples.summary: `Spreadsheet.undo()/redo()` now reveal the selection but still skip `updateFreezeState()`, which the keyboard path does — toolbar-driven undo of a freeze-pane change leaves stale frozen panes
samples.evidence: The keyboard handlers at `packages/sheets/src/view/worksheet.ts:5108-5112` and `:5122-5126` do `updateFreezeState(); render(); scrollIntoView();` after a successful undo/redo. The diff added `revealActiveCell()` to `Spreadsheet.undo`/`redo` (spreadsheet.ts:653-655, 666-667) with the comment "The keyboard path does the same", but omits `updateFreezeState`, so the toolbar undo button (`packages/frontend/src/components/formatting-toolbar.tsx:218`, `:222`) — which calls `spreadsheet.undo()/redo()` — still repaints with the pre-undo freeze state even though `Sheet.replayHistory` reloaded `loadFreezePane()`. Pre-existing divergence that the new comment now claims parity with.

finding.summary: Shared-document sheet view is editable for the `editor` share role but never passes `onUndoJump`/`undoJumpTarget`, so cross-tab undo stays silently broken there — and the new prop doc asserts the opposite
finding.evidence: `packages/frontend/src/app/shared/shared-document.tsx:300` renders `<SheetView tabId={activeTabId} readOnly={readOnly} peerJumpTarget={peerJumpTarget} />` with `readOnly = resolved.role === "viewer"` (line 198), i.e. an `editor`-role share link gets a fully writable engine with Cmd+Z enabled. That layout has its own multi-tab state (`activeTabId`, line 200) and already implements the identical two-step jump for peers (lines 228-237), but no `onUndoJump`/`undoJumpTarget` wiring. With `onUndoJump` omitted, `Sheet.applyUndoSelection` returns early for `otherTab` selections, so an undo of a step in another tab mutates the CRDT and appears to do nothing — exactly the defect this PR fixes for `document-detail.tsx`. The new JSDoc at `packages/frontend/src/app/spreadsheet/sheet-view.tsx:163-167` claims the omission is "the read-only share view … moot there since undo is disabled", which is false for the editor role. verdict.reason: Verified independently. `shared-document.tsx:300` mounts SheetView with only `tabId`/`readOnly`/`peerJumpTarget`; `readOnly` is true only for `role === "viewer"` (line 198), and `share-dialog.tsx:190` shows an `editor`-role share link is a real, reachable configuration. For a non-readOnly mount the engine binds Cmd/Ctrl+Z (`packages/sheets/src/view/worksheet.ts:5102-5113`, gated solely on `this.readOnly`), and `Sheet.applyUndoSelection` (`packages/sheets/src/model/worksheet/sheet.ts:5484-5492`) returns after firing `onUndoTabJump` for `otherTab` selections; `sheet-view.tsx:1082-1084` forwards that to an `onUndoJump` that is `undefined` here, so a cross-tab undo mutates the CRDT and visibly does nothing in the shared layout — which is multi-tab (activeTabId state at line 200, tab strip at 304-325). Repo-wide there are exactly two SheetView consumers (`shared-document.tsx:15`, `document-detail.tsx:72`) and only `document-detail.tsx:762-763` supplies the new props, so no counterexample exists. The JSDoc at `sheet-view.tsx:162-168` justifying the omission ("the read-only share view … moot there since undo is disabled") is factually wrong for the editor role. This is an in-lane unupdated consumer of the contract this change introduced, with a stale/incorrect prop doc.
